items.title: Polarizations represented on torsors are equivalent to theta-group and linear theta-group existence
items.author: Jef Laga
items.difficulty_reason: The full two-level representation criterion requires categorifying polarized abelian torsors, invariant line-bundle classes and theta-group/Schrodinger representation data as gerbes, constructing fully faithful morphisms with the correct central bands, and proving gerbe equivalences with descent. The reverse implications reconstruct geometric torsors/line bundles from abstract central extensions and their representations. Original degree-invertibility and field/base conventions retained. Old block-diagonal commutator lemma belongs to later group-theoretic applications, not this geometric-gerbe equivalence. Both linear and invariant-class clauses form one principal criterion.

primary.label: Complete original two-level theta-group representation criterion

proof_spans.label: Complete original polarizations/theta groups and gerbe/Schrodinger equivalence proofs, including geometric descent and symmetric versions
